text:
toni-rev: Cardinal Health AP emailed: they need the upcoming Private renewal invoice (CH-2026-11) split across three internal cost centers so their ERP can auto-apply to the right GLs. Is that something we support on the customer-facing invoice or do we provide a split schedule/cover memo?

ar-lee: We occasionally do a split schedule attachment. If they want separate invoice lines for each cost center we need a signed billing instruction amendment. Which cost centers and amounts did they ask for?

marta-cs: Customer sent the breakdown in their PO: 
```
CC1001 - Clinical Ops - 60% - $72,000
CC2002 - Research - 25% - $30,000
CC3003 - IT - 15% - $18,000
Total platform fee 12 months (net): $120,000
Support (Gold): $30,000 (bill to CC3003)
```
They want Platform split across three lines and Support billed to IT (CC3003). They attached PO-CH-2026-11B with internal billing instruction.

sam-fin: Finance viewpoint: we can provide a split schedule PDF and AR can apply cash to appropriate GLs, but customer asked for separate invoice lines because their ERP requires line-level cost center mapping. Per policy we need a billing amendment approving split invoice lines since it changes how revenue is presented on the invoice. Do we have an approval or amendment?

marta-cs: No amendment signed. CS spoke to their procurement and they expect us to honor the PO. They said it's standard for them and would be fine with an amendment signed via email confirmation.

billing-bot: Billing run 2026-11-01: invoice generation rule set forbids splitting a single SKU across multiple invoice lines unless Amendment with BILL-SPLIT flag is present. Generated ticket BILL-8333 to process exception.

billing-ops: If legal/finance approve, we can produce a special invoice with three platform lines mapping to the same SKU but with a memo "per PO-CH-2026-11B". Need: 1) signed amendment or explicit written approval from Cardinal (email ok but must be attached), 2) confirmation which GL each line should map to for our AR posting rules. Also need CS to confirm revenue recognition won't be affected (we treat as single performance obligation).

ar-lee: @marta-cs please get their written confirmation referencing PO-CH-2026-11B and include "bill as separate invoice lines" and cost center percentages. Once we have that AR will accept reissue.

marta-cs: I'll request signed email today. Also asking if we should charge an administrative fee for custom invoice formatting (we used to charge a $250 one-time set-up fee for bespoke invoice splits). Customer didn't mention fee. Thoughts?

sam-fin: Finance prefers not to nickel-and-dime for enterprise customers if it's a one-off. If this becomes a recurring request we should formalize pricing. For now waive the $250 and track it as "billing services waiver" in the ticket. I'll note it in the exception approval.

billing-ops: Action items for BILL-8333: (A) CS attach signed email approval to ticket, (B) Billing to reissue CH-2026-11_R1 with platform split lines and Support billed to CC3003, memo "Per PO-CH-2026-11B; see AMND-CH-2026-BILL if signed", (C) AR to map lines to GLs per provided mapping. ETA 2 business days after approval doc received.

toni-rev: I'll loop in Cardinal procurement and request the email confirmation right away. Noting: please keep the split on the invoice only; do not create multiple invoices for accounting.

billing-bot: BILL-8333 updated: awaiting attachment. Reminder: include full PO and cost center mapping in the ticket.

ar-lee: Once we have the approval, AR will hold cash application until corrected invoice posted. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
notes: Customer requested invoice line-level cost center split for Private renewal; billing exception ticket BILL-8333 opened
